fine.definition:
n. money extracted as a penalty
s. minutely precise especially in differences in meaning
s. thin in thickness or diameter
s. characterized by elegance or refinement or accomplishment
fine.translation:
n. 罚款, 罚金, 晴天, 精细
a. 好的, 晴朗的, 健康的, 细小的, 精细的
vt. 罚款, 精炼, 澄清
vi. 变清, 变细
adv. 很好
[计] 精细

fine adjustment.translation:
[化] 细调; 精密校正; 精密调整
[医] 细调整

fine art.translation:
phr. （依靠丰富经验）在…方面的技能达到炉火纯青的地步
n. 美（艺）术（指绘画和雕塑）; 美（艺）术品

fine bank bill.translation: [经] 信誉良好的银行承兑汇票

fine champagne.translation: n. (法国西部的)上等白兰地酒

fine crusher.translation:
[化] 细碎机

fine metal.translation: [化] 纯金属; 精炼金属

fine particle.translation:

[医] 微粒

fine pattern.translation: [计] 精细图案, 精致图

un. 调好的

fine-drawn.translation: a. 精缝的, 拉细的, 过于细致的

fine-grained.definition:

finedraw.definition:
v. t. To sew up, so nicely that the seam is not perceived;
   to renter.

finedrawing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Finedraw

fineer.definition:
v. i. To run in dept by getting goods made up in a way
   unsuitable for the use of others, and then threatening not to take them
   except on credit.
v. t. To veneer.
fineer.translation:
a. 完美的, 完善的；美好的, 极好的；优质的；优良的；上好的, 上等的
adv. ＝ finely；[口语]很好, 好, 行；妙, 适合地
vt. 使精美；使纯；使精细；把…提纯：；使细小；把…缩小(通常与down或away连用)：

fineman.translation: n. (Fineman)人名；(瑞典)菲内曼；(英)法恩曼

finest.definition:

finestill.definition:
